chunks: Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī ibn Maḥbūb, from Bunān ibn Muḥammad, from Mūsā ibn al-Qāsim ibn al-Ḥakam, all together from Abān, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī ʿAbd Allāh, from Abī ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, who said:

“If a Christian woman or a Jewish woman is under a Muslim man, and her child is accused [of illegitimacy], the accuser is punished with flogging, because the Muslim has rendered her protected in chastity.”

key_terms.الْقَاذِفُ: the one who makes the accusation
key_terms.الْمُسْلِمِ: the Muslim husband in this ruling
key_terms.حَصَّنَهَا: has rendered her legally protected in chastity
key_terms.فَيُقْذَفُ: is accused with qadhf, meaning an allegation of sexual dishonor or illegitimacy

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone accuses the child of a Christian or Jewish wife of a Muslim man of illegitimacy?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning qadhf against the child of a Christian or Jewish woman married to a Muslim man. It states that the accuser is to be punished, because the marriage to the Muslim establishes her protected status with respect to chastity in this legal context.
